Name: Colorful Hand Mirrors for Fashion Sense
Author: sweetbeaplays
Description:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/yk78D39/colorful-hand-mirrors-for-fashion-sense.png[/img]

These are .png replacements for the hand mirror icon that can found in Fashion Sense's assets folder. You will still need the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969?tab=description]Fashion Sense[/url] and all required framework ﻿in order to see the hand mirror sprite.

There are 7 different colorways to choose from:
[list=1]
[*][i]Golden Walnut[/i]
Pure gold just the like finest and most valuable nut on earth

[*][i]Haley's Mirror[/i]
Pink just like Haley's favorite cake!

[*][i]Iridium[/i]
For end game inventory purists, this mirror will meet the color of your efforts

[*][i]Slime[/i]
If slimes had hands, they'd own this one

[*][i]Lava[/i]
For those who think they're hot

[*][i]Void[/i]
To all of my Sebastian lovers, a mirror that matches deep thoughts and rainy days

[*][i]Willy's Mirror[/i]
Blue as the deep blue sea (the sea is blue because of the sky but you catch my drift)

[/list][b][size=4]You can find the antique style version of the mirror here at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21343?tab=posts&BH=1]Grandma's Hand Mirror[/url]![/size][/b]
[b][u][size=4]
[/size][/u][/b][img]https://i.ibb.co/WvyBv2j/instructions-for-download.png[/img]﻿

After downloading Fashion sense and the required framework, you can replace the hand mirror .png file of your choosing by navigating to FS main folder>Framework>Assets then drag and drop Grandma's Hand mirror .png into that folder. Say yes to replace file.

If you already have Fashion Sense and own the mirror, this will automatically replace the sprite in your inventory. If you do not own the hand mirror, you can go to Pierre[b] per the mod's instructions[/b] and purchase it there.
